records.name: forum.tag.view.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <list string="Tags" editable="bottom">
                <field name="name"/>
                <field name="color" widget="color_picker"/>
                <field name="forum_id" options="{'no_create_edit': True}"/>
            </list>
        </field>

records.name: forum.tag.view.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form string="Tag">
                <sheet>
                    <group>
                        <field name="name"/>
                        <field name="color" widget="color_picker"/>
                        <field name="forum_id" options="{'no_create_edit': True}"/>
                    </group>
                </sheet>
                <chatter/>
            </form>
        </field>
